answer_1.quote: In each round, an uncensored LLM generates a new claim based on a target persona, the original claim, and previous generated claims.

answer_2.quote: We analyze the linguistic and emotional features of the generated claims using metrics from previous work... Cognitive Effort measures the processing difficulty of the claim using readability and perplexity... Emotion Evocation measures the emotional appeal of the claim using sentiment analysis and morality... Clustering measures the semantic deviations between the generated claims and their original claims...

answer_3.quote: We conduct a questionnaire-based evaluation with 30 university graduates... The same task is performed with GPT-4o-mini.
methods: LLM-based rating simulation of human evaluation questionnaire

answer_4.quote: We conduct a questionnaire-based evaluation with 30 university graduates familiar with American politics.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each claim on four dimensions using a 5-point Likert scale... 1. Role-Playing Consistency... 2. Content Relevance... 3. Fluency... 4. Factuality... They were tasked with assigning veracity labels...
